title: #[non_exhaustive] + Other(String) pattern on all string enums
description: Every string-backed enum (MailboxRole, Delivered, Displayed, UndoStatus, ComparatorProperty) uses #[non_exhaustive] + an Other(String) catch-all variant. This correctly handles JMAP forward compatibility: server extensions can add new role/status values, and clients using this library will not break. Without Other(String), a new server capability would cause deserialization failure. A future contributor might suggest removing Other(String) as 'dead code' or 'unnecessary complexity' — it must be defended: it exists precisely for values we haven't seen yet.
